ui.tagline: Plan one project. Track cost, time, quantity, and a price you choose.

ui.breakEven: How many you'd need to sell
ui.lifetime: Keep every project. Learn what works.
ui.lifetimeBody: Unlock HobbyWorth once to keep building on what you learn from every project. No subscription.
ui.deleteBody: Projects and photos saved by HobbyWorth on this device will be removed. Purchases are not deleted.
ui.local: Projects are saved on this device. Deleting the app can delete them. Export a backup before moving phones.
ui.needTwo: Finish at least two projects to compare them.
ui.freeUsed: Your free project is already in use
ui.freeUsedBody: Finish or replace it, or unlock once to keep it and start another.
ui.spendQ: How much do you want to spend to start?
ui.timeQ: How much time do you have?
ui.goalQ: What do you want from it?
ui.longOpt: I can give it more time
ui.sellOpt: See if I can sell what I make
ui.batchDisclaimer: Informational tool only. Results are estimates based on the numbers you enter. No sales or income are guaranteed. Not financial, legal, tax, or business advice.
ui.numbersLine: Results use only the numbers you enter.
ui.unlockCompare: Compare projects and see which works better for you
ui.unlockScenarios: Try detailed cost splits and price scenarios
ui.unlockExport: Export your project history and backups
ui.unlockHomeBody: Keep every finished project, compare results, try detailed price scenarios, export backups, and remove ads.
ui.settingsUpgradeBody: Unlock once to keep unlimited projects, compare what worked, use advanced pricing tools, export your work, and remove ads.
ui.noAdsActive: Ads are off and all lifetime features are available.
ui.tryAnotherSearch: Try a different search or category.
ui.guideBeforeBody: Start with the first project, use or borrow what you already have, then buy only what removes a real constraint.
ui.guideMonthBody: Repeat the first project at least twice before upgrading equipment. Track what you spend, how long each attempt takes and what you actually use.
ui.guideFitBody: Use cost, time and difficulty together. Pick something that fits both your weekly schedule and the space you actually have.
